title: Your Circles in the left rail shows each Circle's own picture as its icon
detail: Daniel 2026-10-19: in the Your Circles menu, use the profile/logo for each circle as the icon. getMyFrequency now reads circles.image_url and carries it on each entry as `image`; the Frequency rail draws it in the orb (open and folded faces) through CircleMark, falling back to the initial when a Circle has no picture. The unread dot still sits on the orb. The mobile drawer keeps its line icons.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=fs.readFileSync('lib/nav/my-frequency.ts','utf8');const s=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/shell/members-shell.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];if(!m.includes('image: c.image_url'))bad.push('the menu drops the Circle picture');if((s.match(/<CircleMark /g)||[]).length<2)bad.push('a rail face draws the initial only');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1013: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when Your Circles goes back to letters only. Behavior is circle-mark.test.tsx and my-frequency.seeded.test.ts.
